svg.title: ARC-401 Reflected Ceiling Plan — First Floor
svg.text: BALCONY SOFFIT — 50 mm COVE IN THE 180 mm NOSING
External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. The ceiling of the first floor, seen from below. Drawn by
running the floor plan with its sanitaryware, furniture,
door swings and dimension chains switched off, so it
cannot stop agreeing with A-101 when a partition moves.
2. Soffit is +6.30 throughout, 3.00 m clear, under a 300 mm
structural zone. Any local drop below that is a bulkhead
3. A bulkhead is drawn over every room the plan calls wet,
because that is where the drainage runs. The outline is
the room; the depth, the exact extent and everything
inside it are the services engineer's and are set on the
4. No light fitting is drawn. Fittings, switching and
emergency provision are the EL-200 series; a layout
invented here would only have to be thrown away.
5. Ceiling finishes, board type, moisture resistance in the
wet rooms and access panels are specification, not
geometry, and are not set on this sheet.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P18 2026-10-07 scheme A adopted: serpentine balcony on every plan; site named
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
P21 2026-10-07 300 mm external and party walls: brick, colour unrestricted
